name: UALink Consortium specifications index
notes: Index of published UALink specifications: UALink 200G 1.0 (200G per lane scale-up, up to 1,024 accelerators in a pod), UALink Common 2.0 (introduces In-Network Compute), UALink 128G Data Link and Physical Layers 1.0, UALink 200G Data Link and Physical Layers 2.0 (split from the Common spec so physical layers can evolve independently), UALink Chiplet 1.01 (UCIe 3.0 compliant), UALink Manageability 1.0.
